buyingGuideHtml:
Custom Tissues & Wipes Buying Guide

When ordering custom tissues and wipes, start by considering the end user. Pocket-sized tissue packs are ideal for conferences and giveaways, while larger tissue boxes work well for office supply or client gifts. For wipes, think about the use case: antibacterial wipes suit healthcare or gym promotions, while wet wipes are popular for outdoor events. The material matters too—tissues should be soft and strong, while wipes need to be durable enough to hold moisture without tearing.

Decoration options vary by product. Most tissues and wipes can be printed with your logo using flexographic or offset printing for vibrant, full-color designs. For a premium feel, consider foil stamping or embossing on tissue boxes. Keep in mind that small pocket packs have limited print area, so simple logos or text work best. Always request a proof to ensure color accuracy and placement.

Bulk orders are common for promotional tissues and wipes. Typical minimum order quantities start at 100 units for pocket packs and 250 for boxes. As quantities increase, unit costs drop significantly. For large events or corporate programs, ordering 5,000 or more can bring costs under $0.50 per unit. Plan ahead because production lead times range from 10 to 20 business days depending on complexity and quantity.

Common buying mistakes include overlooking the closure type for wipes. Re-sealable lids or labels are essential to keep wipes moist. For tissues, check the ply count—two-ply is standard for quality, but one-ply may be acceptable for budget giveaways. Also confirm the dimensions of the pack or box to ensure it fits your distribution plan. A pocket pack that is too bulky may not be carried by recipients.

Personalized tissues and wipes are effective for a wide range of events. Use them at trade shows to hand out alongside samples, include them in welcome kits for new employees, or send them as part of a corporate gift set. Safety managers can order custom antibacterial wipes for workplace hygiene stations. With the right customization, these everyday items become memorable brand ambassadors.

Finally, consider the environmental impact. Some suppliers offer eco-friendly options like recycled paper tissues and biodegradable wipes. If your company has sustainability goals, ask about these alternatives. They can be a selling point for your brand and resonate with eco-conscious customers. Perfect Imprints can help you source the right product for your needs.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom tissues?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product. Pocket-sized tissue packs typically start at 100 units, while larger tissue boxes may require a minimum of 250 units. For wipes, MOQs are similar. Contact us for specific product requirements.

faqs.q: What decoration methods are available for tissues and wipes?
faqs.a: Common decoration methods include flexographic printing, offset printing, and foil stamping. Flexographic printing is cost-effective for large runs, while foil stamping adds a premium look. Most methods support full-color logos. We recommend simple designs for small packs.

faqs.q: Can I order custom wipes with a resealable lid?
faqs.a: Yes, many wipe products offer resealable lids or labels to keep wipes moist. This is especially important for antibacterial or wet wipes. Specify your preference when ordering, and we will confirm the available options for the chosen product.

faqs.q: What is the typical production lead time?
faqs.a: Production lead times range from 10 to 20 business days after proof approval, depending on the quantity and complexity of the order. Rush services may be available for an additional fee. We recommend ordering at least 3-4 weeks before your event.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available for most products. You can request a blank sample to check size and material, or a printed sample for an additional fee. Contact your account manager to arrange sample delivery.
